## Planned benchmarks

- Separated-locus benchmark with realistic LD.
- High-LD causal architecture.
- Scientific-length MCMC calibration.
- Final scientific-length prediction study (the development implementation is available below).
- Multi-trait study.
- Annotation-informed models.
- Block-eigen methods.

Planned benchmarks are not yet completed or published.

## Development implementations under review

### [Single-trait prediction development benchmark](02_prediction/prediction-development-pilot.qmd)

This complete one-replicate development benchmark compares BayesC and BayesR across BED and CSR representations under sparse homogeneous and sparse variance-mixture architectures. It uses a common 70/30 split, training-only genotype scaling and LD, held-out test phenotypes, and short development MCMC. It validates the workflow without estimating replicate-to-replicate uncertainty.
